log.msg: Root cause found: Sessions.js assign_prompt()/prompt_close_ms (default 8000ms) merges unrelated owner utterances into one Prompt/message when they land within 8s of each other and no assistant reply arrives in between to trigger reply_closes_prompt(). Evidence: v-z0jonhy session.jsonl lines 113-138 — four distinct owner sentences ('In this technological form.'/'You'll answer your question.'/'Thank you.'/'I don't answer your question.') all pushed via PromptLines.push_raw/append_paragraph into the single prompt p-1793729237961 and message m-1793729237967 (sentences.push at lines 121,127,136), because the smart seat was busy (spawning the mastermind task) and sent no reply to close the prompt early; gaps between them (0.2s-5.5s) stayed under prompt_close_ms. Code: Servex/agents/Sessions.js:548-558 (assign_prompt appends to s.prompt while open), :1273-1279 (close_prompt_later, 8s timer), :1281-1286 (reply_closes_prompt — guards against splitting mid-dictation, correctly NOT the cause of hypothesis 2). Hypothesis 2 (reply splits open bubble) is explicitly guarded against by code comment+logic at :1281-1285 (checks this.thoughts.get(s.id)?.lines.length before closing) — no evidence of it firing wrongly in this session. Hypothesis 3 (Whisper chunk overlap/boundary) not supported: every pushed text in session.jsonl is a complete, non-overlapping, grammatically distinct sentence; no raw Whisper bucket.jsonl exists for this session's time window (public/framework/ai/whisper/bucket.jsonl only has an unrelated later 'recite' log run, no entries at 18:04-18:08Z) so could not cross-check raw audio segments directly, but the clean per-utterance text argues against a chunking/overlap bug. Hypothesis 4 (place edits reorder) not supported: each place:{re,to:'same',edit:'improve'} call (lines 10,32,51,71,89,101,131,139,141,144,159,167,182,199) retargets exactly one sentence id via messages.clean, never reorders or touches other sentences. Smallest fix: lower SERVEX_SESSION_PROMPT_CLOSE_MS, or make assign_prompt() also check a max per-prompt owner-gap/semantic-boundary (e.g. close on a '?' or '.' ending plus floor:done) instead of pure elapsed-time, so a slow smart-seat reply no longer leaves a long absorption window. Read-only investigation; no edits made.
